rowType.title: Row type
rowType.description: feed-item for a new item found in a feed, summary for the single run summary row that every successful run writes. Filter on this field to keep only the items.

message.title: Run summary
message.description: Only on the summary row: how many feeds were checked and how many new items appeared, in one sentence.
message.example: No new items: 3 of 3 feed(s) were read and every item they list had already been reported by an earlier run.

runStartedAt.title: Run started at
runStartedAt.description: Only on the summary row: when this run started, UTC.

finishedAt.title: Finished at
finishedAt.description: Only on the summary row: when this run finished, UTC.

sourcesGiven.title: Feeds given
sourcesGiven.description: Only on the summary row: how many feed URLs this run was asked to watch.

sourcesRead.title: Feeds read
sourcesRead.description: Only on the summary row: how many of them answered and were parsed.

sourcesFailed.title: Feeds failed
sourcesFailed.description: Only on the summary row: how many could not be read. The reason per feed is in the REPORT record.

sourcesSkipped.title: Feeds skipped
sourcesSkipped.description: Only on the summary row: how many were skipped because the run hit its charge limit.

sourcesSkippedByRobots.title: Feeds skipped by robots.txt
sourcesSkippedByRobots.description: Only on the summary row: how many feeds were not fetched because the host's robots.txt disallows this Actor's user agent. A robots.txt that cannot be read never blocks a feed.

newItems.title: New items
newItems.description: Only on the summary row: how many items were new in this run. Zero is a valid, complete answer.

chargedEvents.title: Charged events
chargedEvents.description: Only on the summary row: how many pay-per-event units this run charged. The summary row itself is free.

chargeLimitReached.title: Charge limit reached
chargeLimitReached.description: Only on the summary row: true when the run stopped early on its own charge limit.

chargeFailures.title: Charge failures
chargeFailures.description: Only on the summary row: how many charge calls the platform did not answer. The run finishes anyway.

source_url.title: Feed URL
source_url.description: The feed this item came from, as given in the input.

source_title.title: Feed title
source_title.description: Title the feed publishes for itself, empty when the feed has none.

item_id.title: Item id
item_id.description: Identity of the item: the feed's guid or id, the link when there is none, or a hash of the feed URL, title and date. This is what the Actor remembers between runs.

item_title.title: Item title
item_title.description: Title of the item, as plain text.

item_link.title: Item link
item_link.description: URL of the item on the publisher's site, empty when the feed gives none.

item_published_at.title: Published at
item_published_at.description: Publication date in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). When the date cannot be parsed, the feed's own text is kept.

item_summary.title: Summary
item_summary.description: The short description the feed itself publishes, as plain text, cut at 600 characters. Never the full article body.
item_summary.example: The new release adds the export button and fixes the date filter.
